title: Partial return can refund the full bill for only one unit
roles: Billing requests; owner approves POS return
steps: Seed A qty20/sell9000. Finalize A x2 for18000 paise. Request one-unit sellable return with18000 refund. Owner approves through real Rules-protected repository.
expected: Reject refund exceeding9000 paise for one undiscounted A; rejected operation leaves cashNet18000 and stock18.
actual: Approval returned approved; cashNet fell18000->0 for one returned unit. Event records refund18000. Independent maximum is9000.
reproducibility: Repeated in current drill; latest request includes a valid explicit IST refund date. Original failures preserved.
impact: Over-refunds/cash leakage and inconsistent quantity/refund evidence.
fix: Trusted idempotent return posting must derive refundable line net prices after discounts/prior returns and enforce an aggregate cap; UI default must use selected return quantities.

title: Staff can create an orphan refund event
steps: Sign in billingA with real Auth. Direct SDK set posSandboxes/test/events/drill-orphan-refund with type bill-return-approved, nonexistent bill/approval and refund500000 paise.
expected: Rules reject missing approved source and leave events unchanged.
actual: Write succeeded. Canonical event persisted without any bill or approval.
reproducibility: 1 current emulator run; original failure preserved
impact: Forged financial history, misleading net sales/refund summaries and possible closing denial/cashout inconsistency.
fix: Make refund events server-owned and atomically source-validated against approval/bill/revision; forbid independent client creation.

title: Forged movement bypasses stock and price safeguards
roles: Authenticated billing staff; Current Stock/price review/stock posting
steps: Batch a manual-inward movement20->120/revision1->2 and product update qty120/selling100; no GRN, bill, physical count or price callable.
expected: Reject unauthenticated business source; qty20/selling9000 and owner price evidence unchanged.
actual: Batch succeeded: qty120, selling100, revision2. No stockPriceChanges evidence or lastPriceEdit attribution.
reproducibility: 1 current emulator run; original failure preserved
impact: Inventory fabrication, price manipulation, valuation distortion and bypass of owner review despite direct generic price-write denial.
fix: Trusted server stock posting must validate source/actor/revisions independently. Narrow Rules to genuine server-owned records; prevent price mutation through generic movement branches without breaking approved GRN/audit workflows.

title: Critical posting remains browser-owned
steps: Inspect posRepository.ts, vendorLedgerV2Repository.ts, createFinanceActions.ts, store metrics effects and Rules; compare callable exports.
expected: Independently recomputed, idempotent server-controlled business truth for financial/stock posting.
actual: Price change/review and cash transfer use Functions; most other critical posting is browser Firestore transactions/batches. Passing normal tests does not close forged-source gaps.
evidence: src/features/pos/data/posRepository.ts; src/store/vendorLedgerV2Repository.ts; src/store/actions/createFinanceActions.ts; functions/index.js; above current probes
impact: Client payload manipulation and missing cross-document/financial invariants.
fix: Separately design staged trusted posting with intent-only payloads, canonical reads, authorization, independent totals, idempotency and history-preserving cutover. Do not abruptly deny existing client operations.

title: Functions emulator runtime differs from configured production runtime
steps: Start guarded Firebase emulators with installed Node24.14.1 and functions/package.json engine20.
expected: Exact production runtime for runtime-parity acceptance.
actual: CLI logs fallback to host Node24; no dependencies or runtime settings upgraded.
impact: Runtime-specific behavior is not certified on Node20 by this drill.
fix: Rerun callable acceptance using a separately available Node20 toolchain; any production runtime upgrade remains a separate task.

title: Checkout trusts supplied catalogue price and actor role
steps: Authenticate billingA and join. Actual finalizePosBill: A quantity1 at unitPrice1/current revision with cash1. Separately retain billing UID but supply actor.role owner, two A,99% discount17820 and cash180.
expected: Server reads catalogue9000 and actual billing role/cap5%; reject both manipulated payloads without bill/stock/cash effects.
actual: Both accepted. One catalogue9000 item billed for1 paise; the second bill discounted17820/18000 paise and stored supplied owner role for a billing UID.
reproducibility: One current valid-shaped real Auth/Rules run per variant.
impact: Undercharging, forged privilege/attribution and discount-cap bypass.
fix: Trusted idempotent checkout accepts intent only and derives prices/discount permissions/actor from canonical product/profile records. Reject caller-supplied role/financial truth; preserve existing bill history.

title: Direct bill creation can omit stock posting
steps: Create a real A2 bill18000, stock18. Direct SDK clone valid source shapes/native timestamps into a second18000 bill with sequence/cash/state but omit product/movement. Also run direct99.99% forged-price batch.
expected: No second bill without its stock/source invariants; rejected operation leaves one bill/stock18. Two valid A2 bills would imply stock16.
actual: Source-shaped second bill accepted; stock stayed18 despite two bills and cash36000. Direct99.99% batch also accepted with total1 and stock20 unchanged.
reproducibility: Two independent valid-shaped variants on resumed current emulators. Cached-helper earlier apparent passes were invalid and rerun.
impact: Inventory/sales divergence, forged receipts and financial history. The matching live-count variant was rejected by Rules, proving the reservation lock independently.
fix: Server-owned checkout must atomically derive and post catalogue, stock, sequence, payments and handover with revision/source proof. Narrow Rules after a separately approved compatible posting cutover.

title: Matched drawer is labelled excess cash
steps: Open fixture checkpoint100000 paise, no bills/expenses. Owner counts two Rs500 notes and saves Cashout.
expected: Expected/count100000 and discrepancy0 should produce consistent matched audit evidence.
actual: Drawer closure records expected100000,count100000,difference0. Daily Cashout instead records cash-more and auditDifference-1000 rupees because it compares drawer with today cash sales0.
reproducibility: One current full UI/source run; formulas source-confirmed.
impact: Correct drawer is falsely flagged as excess/wrong billing; saved audit fields contradict canonical closure.
fix: Use one explicit drawer reconciliation basis from checkpoint plus ledger deltas. Keep sales summaries separate and resolve expense/payment ownership before changing cash arithmetic.

title: Some financial sources omit immutable actor UID
roles: Billing Register expenses; owner/delegated cash transfers
steps: Save billing expense25 through UI and inspect cashouts. Save owner transfer300 from billingA to billingB and inspect transfer payload/schema.
expected: Financial evidence should retain stable authenticated recorder identity; unavailable historical values remain honestly unavailable.
actual: Billing expense has no creator UID/name (approvedBy is Pending approval). Transfer has server-derived createdBy name, but no immutable recorder UID. Sender UID is not necessarily the recorder.
reproducibility: Current saved records and schema/source confirmed.
impact: Expense creator cannot be traced; name-only transfer attribution can become ambiguous after renames/duplicate names.
fix: Persist authenticated recorder UID and name snapshot on new trusted postings. Do not guess/backfill historical actors; define required audit fields before implementation.

title: Pending expense approval has no active decision workflow
roles: Billing expenses and owner Action Centre
steps: Save a billing Register expense. Compare approvedBy Pending approval with active Action Centre source definitions.
expected: Define whether staff expenses need a real approval state/owner decision or only an informational approver label.
actual: Expense is saved immediately with Pending approval text. Active queue handles cashout/vendor/POS/price/handover sources, not a Register expense approval state.
reproducibility: Source-confirmed; no approval requirement was invented as an implemented feature.
impact: Ambiguous staff/owner expectation and misleading pending label.
fix: Obtain a separate decision on expense approval semantics, then implement enforced states or clear labelling; do not silently invent a new financial approval flow.

title: Cheque overlay lacks dialog semantics and modal focus
steps: Register > Payment Mode Cheque. Inspect role=dialog and focused element while Enter cheque information is visible.
expected: Accessible modal with initial cheque-field focus, trapped keyboard navigation and safe dismissal/return focus.
actual: Zero dialog elements; recorded focus remains on the underlying Payment Mode input. Visual close/cancel creates no expense.
reproducibility: One current browser run plus source confirmation.
impact: Keyboard/screen-reader users can lose context and reach controls behind the overlay.
fix: Reuse shared dialog semantics, initial focus/trap/Escape/return-focus; preserve mandatory-count dismissal requirements elsewhere.

title: NativeSelect discards explicit accessible labels
roles: Logs date range and other explicitly labelled selectors
steps: Logs renders NativeSelect aria-label Date range. Actual textbox has no matching accessible name; inspect NativeSelect prop forwarding.
expected: Passed aria-label/id/description attributes reach the interactive control.
actual: NativeSelect destructures selected props and discards aria-label. Functional Logs tests required a documented visible-value selector fallback.
impact: Selectors are harder to identify through assistive technology; inconsistent keyboard automation.
fix: Forward supported accessibility props to SelectField and its trigger; test accessible names and keyboard use.

title: Broad shared subscriptions and holder reads scale with history
roles: All signed-in roles; Cash Movement and shared finance data
steps: Inspect storeSubscriptions collection snapshots and Functions holder transaction queries; observe target names in the current detail-listener test.
expected: Preserve necessary shared dependencies while bounding/scoping unnecessary historical reads; do not claim production read savings without measurement.
actual: Stock is idle until filters and two detail listeners detach correctly. Global sales/purchases/cashouts/payments/users/vendors/dailyCashouts/transfers remain broad; holder calculations inspect whole canonical collections.
reproducibility: Source/isolated query-target evidence; no production billing or read-count measurement.
impact: Increasing history raises reads, memory and transaction work despite Stock tab improvements.
fix: Separately inventory shared consumers and design date/cursor scopes or canonical holder aggregates with reconciliation. Do not make an unrelated global rewrite as a drill fix.

title: Large initial JavaScript bundle
steps: Fresh scoped TypeScript/Vite build with login bypass/password disabled.
expected: Record actual artifact sizes and benchmark before claiming user-visible latency.
actual: Fresh build: JS1450.56kB, gzip432.93kB; existing >500kB chunk warning. Mobile load timings were not measured.
impact: Potential slower first load and parsing on phones; magnitude remains unmeasured.
fix: Measure cold navigation on target phones, then split workspace modules/dependencies at appropriate boundaries; no dependency upgrade as a shortcut.

title: Staff creation secondary Auth targets a nonlocal endpoint
steps: Use demo config, primary local Auth and real owner. Fill Create User with synthetic data; inspect secondary Auth request.
expected: Every Auth instance must use the local emulator before any write in the drill.
actual: Secondary getAuth is not connected to Auth emulator. identitytoolkit.googleapis.com request was blocked; no synthetic account/profile was created and owner session stayed intact.
reproducibility: One current observed blocked browser flow plus source.
impact: Full-stack staff creation cannot be safely accepted in this environment; no production failure or account creation is claimed.
fix: Separately approve connecting secondary Auth instances through the same emulator-aware initializer. Keep the guard; never redirect silently to production.

title: Installed Android cache refresh remains unverified
steps: Repeat cold installed launch, online update, offline reopen and refresh on a physical Android phone.
expected: Installed app reflects the accepted release and has clear offline/update behavior.
actual: Local manifest/SW assets inspected; dev service workers blocked for isolation. Earlier user reports are context, not a reproduction from this drill.
reproducibility: Not reproduced by this drill; manual acceptance required.
impact: Potential stale installed UI; no present defect asserted.
fix: Verify on device and collect worker/cache/version evidence before changing update policy.

title: Cash Movement double-click creates two transfers
roles: Owner Cash Movement; other permitted roles use the same form
steps: Holder billingA has1000 rupees. Owner selects billingA -> billingB, amount300, one reason, and double-clicks Save Cash Movement. Await both actual callable responses and inspect saved records.
expected: One UI intent posts one300 transfer (30000 paise); holder remainder700 and recipient300.
actual: Two different operation IDs posted300 each: actual debit60000 paise, remainder400 and recipient600. Callable idempotency for the same operation ID still passed; the UI generated two IDs.
reproducibility: Repeated in two current full UI/Functions runs; original failures preserved.
impact: Duplicate cash movement/holder balances from an ordinary repeated click.
fix: Guard the UI immediately while pending, keep one stable operation ID across retries/lost acknowledgements, and retain server idempotency. Show pending/error/retry states without generating a new intent.

title: Staff can create negative owner-labelled expenses
steps: Billing directly SDK-writes cashouts/drill-negative-expense with amount-2500 rupees and approvedBy Drill owner.
expected: Reject negative financial amounts and forged approval attribution; no expense record.
actual: Rules accepted the negative amount and owner approval text. cashouts create requires only active staff. No production record was touched.
reproducibility: One current direct real Auth/Rules run; source condition confirmed.
impact: Expense/net/cash summaries can be distorted; approval label is caller-controlled.
fix: Trusted expense posting validates nonnegative integer paise, actor and defined approval semantics; Rules reject independent malformed financial source creation. Approval-flow changes require a separate decision.

title: Stock audit movement uses UTC business date after IST midnight
roles: All stock-audit staff; source/history business dates
steps: Run during actual 00:00â€“05:29 IST. On13 October perform physical count A20->17 using real server-synchronized app/Rules API.
expected: Movement businessDate is2026-10-13 IST, consistent with the actual count day.
actual: Movement createdAt is12 October UTC, but businessDate is also2026-10-12 because the repository uses timestamp.slice(0,10). Independent IST date is2026-10-13.
reproducibility: One real boundary-window posting, no clock mocking; source formula confirmed.
impact: Stock activity can be attributed to the previous business day; source details disagree with IST event time.
fix: Derive new movement business dates from the shared IST/trusted-clock convention. Inventory other UTC slicing paths; preserve historical records unless a separate correction is approved.
